# Correctness Requirements Checklist: Fix P0 Audit Findings — W5500 ioLibrary_Driver

**Purpose**: Validate the quality, completeness, and clarity of correctness/memory-safety requirements for the 5 P0 deployment-blocker fixes
**Created**: 2026-07-18
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command. Items test requirements quality, not implementation correctness.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 - Are the affected source file and line range documented for each of the 5 fixes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001 through FR-005] — **PASS**: tasks.md T004/T007/T010/T013/T016 cite exact file:line ranges

- [x] CHK003 - Is the prescribed code change unambiguously specified for AUD-005 (ctlwizchip NULL deref) — specifically, are all commands that require vs. don't require arg enumerated? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005] — **PASS**: T016 enumerates CW_SYS_LOCK/CW_SYS_UNLOCK/CW_GET_SYSLOCK (require arg, W6100/W6300 only) vs CW_RESET_WIZCHIP/CW_INIT_WIZCHIP (accept NULL)
- [x] CHK004 - Are PR branching requirements specified: fork source, target repo, target branch, and what constitutes a single atomic fix? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §FR-007] — **PASS**: FR-006/FR-007 specify fork→Wiznet:master; tasks T003-T017 create branches from fork/master; T005/T008/T011/T014/T017 verify single-commit atomicity
- [x] CHK005 - Are the preconditions for each fix's verification test defined (e.g., ASan/UBSan flags, mock setup, optimization level)? [Completeness, Quickstart.md] — **PASS**: T019 specifies `gcc -fsanitize=address,undefined -D_WIZCHIP_=5500`, mock SPI stubs, -O0/-O2
- [x] CHK006 - Is a "done" definition specified for each fix beyond code change — e.g., ASan clean run, canary check, fault-free execution? [Completeness, Spec §SC-004] — **PASS**: SC-004 + T019 (ASan/UBSan) + T020 (root-cause review) + T018 (multi-chip compile)
